name: io.github.schemacrawler/schemacrawler-ai
description: Enables natural language schema queries — explore tables, keys, procedures, and get SQL help fast

environmentVariables.description: MCP Server transport type - valid values are 'http' or 'stdio', defaulting to 'stdio'.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_MCP_SERVER_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Database user name. Can be optional depending on the database connection type.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_DATABASE_USER

environmentVariables.description: Database user password. Can be optional depending on the database connection type.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_DATABASE_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Optional JDBC URL for database connection. If nonblank, server, host, port, and database are ignored. Credentials may still be supplied separately.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_JDBC_URL

environmentVariables.description: SchemaCrawler database connector identifier, for example, 'sqlserver' or 'sqlite'. Required if the JDBC URL is blank or unset.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_SERVER

environmentVariables.description: Database host. Defaults to the connector's host default. Used only if the JDBC URL is blank or unset.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Database port. Valid decimal values from 1024 through 65535 are used; otherwise the connector's default port is retained. Used only if the JDBC URL is blank or unset.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Optional database name or connector-specific database value. Used only if the JDBC URL is blank or unset.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_DATABASE

environmentVariables.description: Optional stable alias used to identify this database server in MCP instructions and tool results.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_DATABASE_ALIAS

environmentVariables.description: Optional description of this database server, included in MCP instructions and the about_database response.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_DATABASE_DESCRIPTION

environmentVariables.description: How much database metadata to retrieve: 'minimum', 'standard', 'detailed', or 'maximum'. Defaults to 'standard'; unset or unrecognized values also use 'standard'.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_INFO_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Java logging level. Defaults to 'INFO'. Java logging names such as 'SEVERE', 'WARNING', 'INFO', 'CONFIG', 'FINE', 'FINER', 'FINEST', 'ALL', and 'OFF', and numeric levels are accepted.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: MCP Server tools to exclude, as a comma-separated list.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_EXCLUDE_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a serialized offline catalog snapshot. When set, catalog loading uses this snapshot.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_OFFLINE_DATABASE

environmentVariables.description: Additional SchemaCrawler configuration encoded as a JSON object. Invalid JSON logs a warning and uses empty additional configuration; do not include secrets.
environmentVariables.name: SCHCRWLR_ADDITIONAL_CONFIG
